headline: US futures point to mixed open with tech under pressure ahead of durable goods data and heavy pre-market earnings slate as oil trades near $102
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) are down 0.12%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) edge higher by 0.02%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) decline 0.39%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) fall 0.18% in early trade
- Coca-Cola (KO), Boeing (BA), UPS (UPS), Corning (GLW), and HCA Healthcare (HCA) are scheduled to report earnings before the open, setting up potential single-stock volatility
- US durable goods orders data are due at 8:30 AM ET, followed by consumer confidence and new home sales releases at 10:00 AM ET
- Overnight Asian shares advanced, led by a 1.73% gain in the Nikkei (@NKD)
- European markets were mostly higher in the prior session
- WTI oil futures (@CL) ticked up modestly near $102 while gold (@GC) declined
- Monday’s session benefited from AI-related sentiment tied to Anthropic (ANTW)’s IPO filing, though current futures point to a pause in that momentum
